question: Why is omeprazole short, and what do we do?

steps.title: Our stock in three hospitals
steps.purpose: Read on-hand stock and 28-day use where each hospital keeps it.
steps.finding: 3 stock lines across 2 hospitals, 1 presentation, in units of use.

steps.title: Where our supply is made
steps.purpose: Follow each product's label to the plants it names, and place each plant in FDA's registration file.
steps.finding: 2 plant links on 2 labels; 2 placed in FDA's registration file.

steps.title: What FDA says about this shortage
steps.purpose: Read FDA's current shortage list and its history for this drug.
steps.finding: Not on FDA's current shortage list.

steps.title: Who else makes it

steps.finding: 53 labelers make it in this form.

steps.title: What FDA found at those plants
steps.purpose: Read every FDA drug inspection, warning letter, import alert and recall for these plants.
steps.finding: 12 inspections (1 OAI at our plants), 1 compliance actions, 0 import-alert listings, 0 recalls.

steps.title: What FDA wrote at the OAI inspections
steps.purpose: Read the Form 483 observations recorded at those inspections.

steps.title: What our P&T committee already approved
steps.purpose: Read Corvale General's approved interchanges for these items.

steps.title: Which links can't be trusted
steps.purpose: Run the semantic layer's key rules (NDC and unit of use) over each hospital's stock, and name the rows they reject.
steps.finding: 11 stock rows across the system fail the NDC rule; 0 of them are this drug. Every row is in a shared unit of use.

steps.title: What we decided last time
steps.purpose: Recall past decisions on this drug from H-MEM, with who approved them.
steps.finding: No past decisions on this drug.

explanation.headline: Omeprazole is not on FDA's shortage list as of 2026-10-21; supply traces to two registered plants with VAI inspections

sentences.text: FDA's records show omeprazole is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale General holds 494 capsules of the 20 mg presentation at 19.1 per day, giving 25.9 days on hand.
Corvale East holds 36 capsules at 8.6 per day, giving 4.2 days on hand.
The rule‑ranked option is to transfer 85 capsules of 20 mg from Corvale General to Corvale East, which would leave the sender with two weeks' supply and bring the receiver to 14 days.
One source at Corvale General is labeled by Proficient Rx LP (FEI 3011557028), a registered plant whose most recent FDA inspection was classified VAI on 2022-12-08.
The other source is labeled by Bryant Ranch Prepack (FEI 1000519407), a registered plant whose most recent FDA inspection was classified VAI on 2026-07-16.
Alternate manufacturers Advanced Rx Pharmacy of Tennessee, LLC and Advanced Rx of Tennessee, LLC are not on the FDA shortage list today, but their labels name no plant we could place.
